result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are a couple of visible content and layout issues near the lower portion of the screen.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation visibly overlaps and obscures the second popular restaurant card, cutting off its image and likely its details.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the fixed navigation layering so cards can be fully viewed above it.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel shows two apparently identical Green Bowl Poké cards with the same image, name, delivery time, and price, which looks like duplicated content.
issues.suggestion: Verify the restaurant data and replace the duplicate card with a distinct listing, or remove it if the duplication is unintended.
